neighbours.label: words of choice and dependence (depends, choose, choice)
fire: How long the paint takes to dry really depends on the humidity.
At the cafe you get to choose your own toppings for the waffle.
The choice of venue for the wedding was left to the bride.
Prices vary depending on the season and the size of the room.
Whether the bridge opens on time depends on the weather.
Students may choose between two essay questions on the exam.
His choice of words at the meeting upset several people.
The dose is adjusted depending on the patient's weight.
quiet: How long the paint takes to dry is about four hours in summer.
At the cafe they serve the waffle with strawberries and cream.
The venue for the wedding was a barn outside the village.
Prices rose sharply this season for the larger rooms.
The bridge opened on time despite the heavy rain.
Students wrote two essays on the exam last week.
His words at the meeting were short and polite.
The dose is printed on the label of every bottle.

notes: Weak pole (max 11.6). ' depends' x3, ' choice' x2, ' depending' x2, ' choose'; also the comma in def __init__(self, ...). The + pole is a stronger version of choice/selection.
